verdict.rationale: LangGraph explicitly supports durable execution that 'persists through failures and can run for extended periods, automatically resuming from exactly where they left off,' plus production deployment infrastructure and CLI (`langgraph dev`/`langgraph deploy`) built for 'stateful, long-running workflows,' which together enable autonomous background automations. However, community discussion shows open questions about deploying/production-hardening LangGraph as an API beyond local dev, and there's no first-party or independent evidence of native scheduling/triggering (cron-like) for fully hands-off automation. Missing for 10: independent hands-on validation of true unattended background runs, native scheduling/trigger primitives beyond durable resumption.
